features.probability: q=confidence when released p2 label=1, otherwise 1-confidence

objective_audit.acceptance: both lower bounds>0 and no typed-loss increase versus either control
objective_audit.retention: Identical retention-question resamples across all five windows; each draw retains the maximum window Brier increase; its upper 95 percent bound must be <=0.01. Inherited 10000 draws and seed 7258421 remain fixed.

objective_updates.initial_state: original qualified Exp8431 full spline/scaler/temperature, never Exp8445
objective_updates.restart: real exit after block2 seed17 every arm; exact predictions/state; wrong-rule rejection
objective_updates.shuffle: only admitted labels released in current block
objective_updates.transactions: Transaction 1 seals all predictions and target-blind admissions. Release admitted labels. Tentatively update selected questions in original block order and siblings in release order, one inherited sparse step per valid label. Transaction 2 commits all released updates, applied IDs, acknowledgment IDs and next cursor together. Recovery from sealed predictions replays tentative updates; committed updates advance without reapplying labels. Stable acknowledgments make delivery idempotent.
